datasets.purpose: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Kenya to estimate populations acutely food insecure under different scenarios. The 2019 dataset aggregates these field-collected impact estimates into a structured time series of affected population counts.
